description: Update a campaign (partial; empty values are NOT cleared — list a column in clear_fields to blank it). status: draft|active|paused|completed.

bcc_emails.description: Blind-copy archive for EVERY send of this campaign — array or comma-separated string. Set as a real BCC, never appended to 'to'. Put it here rather than on each call: a call parameter can be forgotten, a campaign field cannot. Pass bcc_emails in clear_fields to switch the archive off.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to change

clear_fields.description: Column names to set to NULL (opt-in clear).

daily_call_target.description: Number of calls planned per day (integer)

email_signature.description: E-mail signature used for this campaign's mails

name: update_campaign
